#  44416 - Design and Optimization of Process Plants I Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **44416 - module is no longer offered from WS 2014/15**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Design and Optimization of Process Plants I**  |  
|  Auslegung und Optimierung prozesstechnischer Anlagen I   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 4 - Environmental Sciences and Process Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Witt, Werner 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Documentation, design, operation and optimization of process plants (basics)   |  
| Contents:  |  **Basics:**
  * Documentation of process plants, structure of plant design
  * Calculation of plant and product costs
  * Practical training of plant operation

Exercise: Practical training of CAE (application of (Comos PT Software) **Optimization:**
  * Material-, enthalpy- and exergy balances
  * Optimization of the process and plant (raw material, energy, effluent, cost)
  * Case studies

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Strongly recommended: Fundamentals of mathematics, physics (thermodynamics, heat- and mass-transfer)   |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 3 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Practical training / 1 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 90 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * Lecture notes 
  * Power Point, Video, CAE (ComosPt) via Internet/Intranet/My BTU
  * Literature: see lecture notes 

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Participation at exercises and practical training (min. 70%)
  * Exercise and practical training reports
  * Written examination 90 min. 

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | **No courses offered in SS 2013!**  |  
| Module Components:  | None  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
